metadata.case_name: CHAU WING CHUEN v. JENKINS ROY IAN AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: neck sprain with soft tissue involvement
source: the plaintiff probably had a neck sprain with soft tissue involvement.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified strain or sprain of cervical spine

injuries.description: minimal broad-based posterior disc bulges at C4/5 and C5/6 levels with slight indentation of the thecal sac
source: MRI scanning of cervical spine showed loss of the normal cervical lordosis and minimal broad-based posterior disc bulges at C4/5 and C5/6 levels with slight indentation of the thecal sac. There was no associated spinal cord compression or exiting nerve root impingement.
the doctor agreed that there was an element of ... mild 4-5th cervical intervertebral disc prolapse.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the neck

injuries.description: mild focal thickening with increased signals of his right subscapularis tendon near its insertion site at less tuberosity (features suspected of partial tear)
source: A MRI scan was done of the right shoulder too and that revealed mild focal thickening with increased signals of his right subscapularis tendon near its insertion site at less tuberosity. There was no complete tendon disruption but the features were suspected of partial tear.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of muscle or tendon of the rotator cuff of shoulder

source: the plaintiff was still affected by the left wrist scapho-lunate ligament injury when the Accident occurred.
the complaint of symptoms and signs of left lateral epicondylitis when the plaintiff was seen on 10 September 2015
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injury of other extensor muscle, fascia or tendon at forearm level

manifestations.description: persistent stretching pain and pin-prick sensation at posterior neck and occiput, more on the right side
on and off paraesthesia of right upper limb, from shoulder to elbow
mild weakness in the right upper limb and subjective claim of 10-20% sensory loss in right arm
limited range of motion of right shoulder due to pain and tenderness at the subacromial region
residual left wrist pain, weakness and numbness
loss of the normal cervical lordosis (noted on MRI)

treatments_received.treatment: taken by ambulance to the Accident & Emergency Department of Tuen Mun Hospital
source: He was taken by ambulance to the Accident & Emergency Department of Tuen Mun Hospital (“TMH”) on 8 December 2013.
X-ray and CT scanning were carried out which showed no bony fractures or intracranial lesions.

treatments_received.treatment: treated conservatively and discharged with painkillers, analgesic balm and given sick leave
source: The plaintiff was treated conservatively and discharged with painkillers, analgesic balm and given sick leave.

treatments_received.treatment: admitted for testing and observation at Tsuen Wan Adventist Hospital
source: the plaintiff attended Tsuen Wan Adventist Hospital (“TWAH”) on 10 December 2013 and was admitted for testing and observation.
MRI scanning of cervical spine showed loss of the normal cervical lordosis and minimal broad-based posterior disc bulges at C4/5 and C5/6 levels with slight indentation of the thecal sac.

treatments_received.treatment: MRI scan of the right shoulder
source: A MRI scan was done of the right shoulder too and that revealed mild focal thickening with increased signals of his right subscapularis tendon near its insertion site at less tuberosity.

treatments_received.treatment: physiotherapy (25 sessions at TMH until 25 August 2014)
source: He then underwent a total of 25 sessions of physiotherapy at TMH until 25 August 2014, when he was discharged due to static progress.
In addition, he attended 4 sessions of hydrotherapy from 9-30 May 2014.

treatments_received.treatment: occupational therapy (35 sessions from 21 August 2014 up to 2 March 2016)
source: 35 sessions of occupational therapy were also received by the plaintiff, from 21 August 2014 up to 2 March 2016.

treatments_received.treatment: further outpatient physiotherapy (7 sessions from 12 January 2016 to 18 April 2016)
source: From 12 January 2016 to 18 April 2016, the plaintiff attended 7 further sessions of outpatient physiotherapy in TMH.

treatments_received.treatment: consultations at Lady Trench General Out Patient Clinic, Tsing Yi Town General Out Patient Clinic and Dr Lai Sing Hung for pain medication and/or sick leave
source: The plaintiff then went to other clinics to receive pain medication and/or sick leave, including Lady Trench General Out Patient Clinic (“LTGOPC”), Tsing Yi Town General Out Patient Clinic and one Dr Lai Sing Hung.

treatments_received.treatment: acupuncture and fire cupping therapy at Herbal Medicine Clinic
source: there are only four other relevant bills, two of Dr Lai Sing Hung and two others of Herbal Medicine Clinic where the plaintiff had acupuncture and fire cupping therapy.

treatments_received.treatment: two operations on left wrist (2012) treated in TMH and Pok Oi Hospital
source: The experts recorded the plaintiff having a fall during work in 2012 which resulted in his left wrist being injured. The plaintiff was then treated in TMH and Pok Oi Hospital (“POH”) with two operations done.
treatments_received.vmis_procedure: Closed reduction for Colles' fracture with percutaneous k-wire fixation

treatments_received.treatment: sick leave granted (total 263 days from 9 December 2013 to 28 August 2014)
source: The plaintiff was granted a total of 263 days of sick leave from 9 December 2013 to 28 August 2014.
